did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. Rahim Traders opened Change on his phone case, unticked "Buyers can pay when it arrives (cash on delivery)" and saved. He opened the form again, and a buyer opened the product page.

checks.text: The seller's form has the switch, with the words "Off: buyers must pay online first, and you are paid after it is delivered."
After saving, the form opens with the switch off (the choice is kept)
The buyer's product page changes from "You pay when it arrives" to "You pay online first. The seller sends it after that."

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.
A real fault was found here and fixed: the seller's switch was shown and said "Saved." but was never stored, so cash on delivery stayed on. It is stored now (new automatic test: CashOnDeliveryTest).

shots.caption: The seller unticked cash on delivery on this product
The buyer's page now says: You pay online first
